tasha: Quick postmortem follow-up from last night's authz incident. Root causes: token lib edge-case, role-owner drift, audit ingest lag, secrets not fully propagated to staging. Need owners + due dates to close remediations.

 tasha: Short remediation list: 1) Upgrade token lib + strict exp checks -> @ben.p -> 36h. 2) Role ownership registry + weekly diff -> @liam -> 5d. 3) Audit-ingest alert + backfill dry-run -> @sam.d -> 48h. 4) Secrets-sync reconciler + healthcheck -> @infra-owner -> 72h.

 ben.p: I’ll take token lib. Vendor v2.1.3, add robust exp parsing, unit tests, canary to dev.

 liam: I’ll own role registry. Will produce CSV of role->owner, push automated weekly diff, request platform review.

 sam.d: For audit ingest I’ll add an alert when audit.ingest.lag > 30m and a backfill job with dry-run first. ETA 48h.

 infra-owner: Secrets-sync: building reconciler that compares secret versions across envs and retries without mass restarts. Will add GET /secrets-sync/status.

 tasha: Please paste a one-line acceptance with epoch due timestamp. I’ll create reminders and add to the remediation tracker.

 ben.p: :thumbsup: I accept — Due: 1965130721 (36h).

 liam: :thumbsup: I accept — Due: 1965545521 (5d).

 sam.d: :thumbsup: I accept — Due: 1965314721 (48h).

 infra-owner: :thumbsup: I accept — Due: 1965593521 (72h).

 tasha: Two cross-team asks: (1) add role CSV to tracker; (2) schedule a monthly pattern check for "token+perm" regressions — we saw 4 related incidents this year.

 liam: Will add CSV and enable weekly diff. I can generate an incident-pattern report for monthly review.

 security-bot: Reminders created: T-24h and T-4h for accepted items. Weekly digest for tag "authz" enabled. :robot_face:

 ben.p: Note for PR: vulnerable case was float `exp` parsing + `==` checks. Example I’ll include: `exp_ts = int(float(payload["exp"]))
if now >= exp_ts: deny()`

 sam.d: I’ll post dry-run results here before executing backfill.

 infra-owner: PR for reconciler runbook by EOD.

 tasha: Thanks all. Tracker link posted to #sec-ops. Reopen if blockers.
